**Finding: Compliant** — no redline needed.

The Agreement imposes no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant on us:

- **Text searches** for "solicit", "employ", "hire", "induce", "recruit", "personnel" and "staff" surfaced only § 7 (Unsolicited Commercial E-Mail), the access-restriction covenant in § 8(c), and incidental "employees" references in the § 12 indemnities.
- **Full read of the two likely locations** flagged by the plan — § 8 (Covenants and Warranties of Client) and § 10 (Confidentiality) — confirms no hiring restriction is tucked into our covenants or the confidentiality obligations.
- **One cross-reference noted:** § 8(d) (p0054) refers to a separate "Non-Competition Agreement", but only to bound TrueLink's licence to use Credit Data — not personnel hiring. That instrument sits outside this document; if it is in the deal package, it is worth a separate check for a non-solicit binding us.

This is our preferred position (no non-solicit on the Customer), so we take no action rather than importing the mutual fallback.
